title: White Rice with Lentils, No Added Fat

content.title: About
content.content: White rice with lentils, no added fat is a ready‑to‑eat product consisting of boiled white rice and red lentils prepared without oil or other fats. It provides a blend of easily digestible carbohydrates and plant protein, along with fiber and micronutrients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The rice‑lentil combination is a staple in Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisines.
Lentils contain three times more protein than most cereal grains.
White rice is quickly absorbed, while lentils slow the rise of blood sugar, making the dish more balanced.
The product contains no added fats, suitable for low‑calorie diets.
Cooking without oil preserves the natural flavors of the ingredients.

items.title: Plant‑based protein source
items.content: Lentils provide about 9 g of protein per 100 g of product, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: The rice‑lentil mix delivers roughly 5 g of fiber, aiding digestion and promoting satiety.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: Absence of added fats makes the dish suitable for calorie‑restricted eating plans.

items.title: Contains iron and folate
items.content: Lentils are a good source of iron and folic acid, important for blood formation and nervous system health.

items.title: Supports blood‑sugar stability
items.content: Fiber and slowly digestible carbs help keep glucose levels steady after meals.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to lentils.

items.title: High glycemic index of rice
items.content: White rice has a high GI, so people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Phytic acid
items.content: Lentils contain phytic acid, which can reduce mineral absorption when consumed in excess.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The dish can be enjoyed as a standalone meal or added to salads, soups, and vegetable stews. It reheats well in the microwave or on the stovetop; feel free to season with herbs, spices, or a squeeze of lemon.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. When frozen, keep for up to 3 months. Discard if you notice off‑odors, discoloration, or mold.
